name: Cortellis CMC Intelligence
description: The Cortellis CMC Intelligence MCP connects Claude to Clarivate’s trusted, human-curated global regulatory CMC content, covering both pre- and post-approval requirements for small molecule and biologic drug products. It enables users to ask natural language questions and provides accurate, referenced answers supported by authoritative regulatory sources. Users can access subscribed and licensed content and navigate complex guidance directly within Claude. Designed for life sciences and regulatory teams, this connector delivers fast, transparent, and compliant insights, helping users accelerate research, reduce manual effort, and make better-informed decisions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Cortellis CMC Intelligence to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Cortellis CMC Intelligence to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.clarivate.com/lifesciences/mcp-cmc/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Cortellis CMC Intelligence MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cortellis CMC Intelligence provides these MCP tools: Cortellis_CMC_Intelligence_Agent.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Cortellis CMC Intelligence?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Cortellis CMC Intelligence in health-life-sciences on the Manufact MCP catalog include Groupon, SNOMED CT Terminology, Rhizome AI - FDA & HA Regulatory Research, Aiva, and Amass Connector.

_published_faq.name: Does Cortellis CMC Intelligence MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cortellis CMC Intelligence requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Cortellis CMC Intelligence is developed by Clarivate. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
